title: custodian change spec v1
description: One bounded operation on the code: what to make or change, where, within which write scope, and what must hold after. A key marked as repeating is written once per value.

name.description: The spec's name: its file's name.

objective.description: What the change is for, in the asker's words.

operation.description: What the writer does (the operations table in custodian_kit's README).
enumDescriptions: a new struct in a module (target: crate:<name> or crate:<name>/src/<file>.rs): name, fields with types and visibility, derives, attributes, docs
a new enum in a module: name, variants (unit, tuple or named fields, discriminants), derives, attributes, docs
a new inherent impl block for a type (target: the type), with its functions
a function added to a type's impl (target: the type): its signature and body, or a toolkit method generator
a free function in a module: its signature and body
a field added to a struct (target: the struct); with a default, every struct literal gets it too
a variant added to an enum (target: the enum); the matches without a catch-all arm are listed, never edited
derives added to a type (target: the type), merged into its #[derive(..)]
one attribute line placed on an item (target: the item)
a new module: its own file and its `mod` line in the parent (target: the parent route)
a dependency line in a crate's Cargo.toml (target: crate:<name>); `optional = true` makes it optional, and the lock file cargo writes is written with it

a test function (target: the function it proves): in the file's tests module (`to`: another inline test module of the file, by name; one the file does not have is made, `#[cfg(test)]`), its body from toolkit pieces
a constructor for a type (target: the type): `Self { field: param, .. }`, or a toolkit constructor generator
`impl Trait for Type` (target: the type): a toolkit impl generator, or the trait's functions

a function's signature changed (target: the function): a new parameter with the expression its call sites pass (inside a macro's arguments too; refused while a call site is unresolved, unless `call_sites.allow_unresolved`), a new name, a new return type; with `function.body`, its body written in the same step (a body that compiles only against the new signature)
an item renamed (target: the item) at its declaration and every use klepto resolves to it
an item moved to another module (target: the item, `to`: the module route), re-exported where it was so its paths still resolve
items moved out of a file into a new module of their own (`items`, `module`), re-exported where they were

an item put behind a crate feature the crate declares (target: the item, `feature`); an item already gated by it is refused. Code that compiles only with the feature on gets its gate as it is made, in the same step: `#[cfg(feature = "..")]` in the function's `attrs` (add_method, make_fn, add_test)
a linkage record's comment anchor placed above an item (target: the item, `linkage`: the record's name)

a function's body replaced (target: the function, `function`: its name and the new body as toolkit pieces); its signature, docs and attributes kept, so its callers are untouched; with a toolkit method generator (`function.generator`) the whole function is written as the call, its signature, docs and attributes inside it

a dependency a crate already names, changed (target: crate:<name>, or `*`: every crate of the workspace naming it; `dependency`, or several in `dependencies` so a family moves together): its source becomes what the spec names (a version alone is the registry's, the path dropped; a path, with or without a version), features given replace its features; `optional` true or false, alone (its source kept) or with the rest

a function's body put in place of every call to it (target: a free function, or an associated one without self): each call becomes a block that binds the parameters to the call's arguments with `let`, then the body; the function is removed when it is not `pub` and every use of it was a call

a function's body wrapped (target: the function, `function`: its name and the pieces that run first): the pieces, then the body as it was, as one block; its signature, docs and attributes kept, so its callers are untouched

a crate's library root, src/lib.rs, made beside its binary (target: crate:<name>, a crate with no library; `module.doc`: the file's inner doc): cargo builds it as the crate's library, and the binary reaches it by the crate's name

a dependency a crate names, dropped from its manifest (target: crate:<name>; `dependency`: its name): refused while a feature names it or a source file of the crate still names its paths (each place said), then proved by the compile

every path through one crate in a crate's sources made a path through another (target: crate:<name>; `dependency.name`: the crate the paths name now, `new_name`: the crate they name after): `old::` becomes `new::`, `use old` and `extern crate old` with it, in every source file of the crate; proved by the compile

a crate feature declared in its Cargo.toml (target: crate:<name>, `feature`: the name, `enables`: what it turns on, each `dep:<name>` (an optional dependency), `<dependency>/<feature>` or another feature of the crate); a feature the crate already declares gets the list given

features.description: A feature. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

optional.description: true: the dependency is optional (a feature turns it on with dep:<name>); false: required again.

dependencies.description: change_dependency: a dependency changed with the others, so a family moves together. Repeats: one block per value, in order.

features.description: A feature. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

optional.description: true: the dependency is optional (a feature turns it on with dep:<name>); false: required again.

to.description: move: the module route the item goes to; add_test: the inline test module (tests when unset).

items.description: extract: an item moved out. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

feature.description: gate: the crate feature; declare_feature: the feature declared.

enables.description: declare_feature: what the feature turns on (dep:<name>, <dependency>/<feature>, another feature). Repeats: one value per line, in order.

pass.description: The expression each call passes for the new parameter.

allow_unresolved.description: true: go ahead with call sites klepto could not resolve, listed for a person; unset, the preflight refuses while any is unresolved.

call_sites.description: change_signature: what the call sites get.

compatibility.description: preserve (every existing use keeps compiling) or break.
enumDescriptions: keep every existing use compiling: a new field needs its default, a moved item its re-export, a new parameter the expression its call sites pass
existing uses may stop compiling; the preflight lists them and the cargo check over the target and its dependents says which

read.description: A route the change may read. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

write.description: A route the change may write (empty: the target's own file). Repeats: one value per line, in order.

scope.description: What the change is authorized to read and write.

features.description: A feature configuration that must still build: default, none, all, or a feature. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

validate.description: A validation after the change: check, affected_tests, test:<name>. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

postconditions.description: What must hold after: exists <item>, resolves <path>, absent <item>. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

decisions.description: A decision the change cannot make itself. Repeats: one block per value, in order.

options.description: An option. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

same_expansion.description: The change keeps what the function compiles to (a body swapped for the toolkit calls whose expansion it already is): cargo expand of the target before and after, the same tokens in the normal form, is a postcondition of the transform.
